summary: Recent M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY. Strong Python programmer with hands-on AI application development experience: fine-tuned transformer models in PyTorch and Hugging Face, integrated an LLM API into a real-time voice-controlled application served over a Flask-SocketIO backend, and compressed TinyLlama 1.1B by ~55% GPU memory with under 1% accuracy loss. Experienced in data preprocessing, model performance monitoring, and deployment pipelines (ONNX, TFLite, TensorRT).

experience.title: AI/ML Intern
bullets: Fine-tuned DONUT (OCR-free visual document understanding transformer) on a custom medical billing dataset for structured field extraction.
Built preprocessing and training pipelines in PyTorch using HuggingFace VisionEncoderDecoder API with domain-specific special tokens.
Improved validation accuracy from 55% to 93% via improved preprocessing and model tuning.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Curated and annotated a custom detection dataset; trained YOLOv8n on 1,133 images achieving 83% mAP@50 on held-out validation, exported to ONNX and TFLite for mobile deployment.

experience.title: Python Developer Intern
bullets: Developed a Python GUI using PyQt and Matplotlib for real-time data acquisition and experimental visualization in a laboratory environment.
Used GitLab for version control and JupyterHub for collaborative data analysis and technical documentation.

experience.title: Research Fellowship
bullets: Engineered a custom data preprocessing pipeline for the BraTS 2020 multi-modal MRI dataset with imaging augmentation and batch-loading memory management.
Led a cross-cultural team of 7 as the sole ML-experienced student, delivering the full pipeline within the 6-week window.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled AI Application (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Built a three-layer distributed AI application: Flutter client, Flask-SocketIO backend, and Jetson edge controller linked by a unified WebSocket API fabric.
Integrated Gemini LLM intent classification (<500ms) for natural-language command understanding and TensorRT-optimized inference (5.2x speedup) into the live serving path.
Resolved 11 integration failures; achieved 100% task reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end latency through systematic testing and validation.

projects.name: SLM Compression and Benchmarking for Edge Deployment
bullets: Reduced GPU memory footprint by ~55% via 8-bit quantization (bitsandbytes LLM.int8()) on TinyLlama 1.1B; profiled peak VRAM and inference latency using pynvml and psutil.
Benchmarked across HellaSwag, GSM8K, and ARC; <1% accuracy degradation with +0.09 perplexity increase, demonstrating near-lossless compression.
